verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-019 [witness: verification:credential_security_policy_client_portal].
statements: INV-019: new staff passwords satisfy R16 length/control-character policy and are hashed exactly as supplied without trimming or normalization
verdicts.why: The check detects trimming or normalization by requiring the exact supplied password to verify and its trimmed form to fail. It does not test rejection of passwords violating the R16 length or control-character rules.

statements: INV-003: passwords, session tokens, viewer access tokens and service credentials are stored only in verification/hash form and never logged
quotes: if plaintext in first_hash or plaintext in second_hash:
verdicts.why: The check detects plaintext leakage into generated password hashes and verification-secret hashes. It does not inspect persisted session tokens, viewer access tokens, or service credentials, and it does not check logs or prove that any credential type is stored only in verification/hash form.
